get.summary: WebSocket (Upgrade; the upgrade itself is answered before the ordinary sign-in, because a browser cannot send a header, and signs in by its first message). The first message is {"type":"auth","token":...}; the token is never in the address. Then the caller's own `notification`, `count` and `approval` events and `changed` (an area name, after any change made through the API), a ping every 25 seconds. Capped per person and per tenant.
